changed_conditional_fields: DB69 trailing field follows the moved script low byte.
D57C and EE65 alternate record fields follow their shared jump operands.
Audio AA49 retains its literal note encoding; its conditional target does not follow the moved AC7F label.
The secondary mode-gate fragment includes the BNE before the two PLAs; ordinary entry remains unproven.
The two main-state coordinate callers select a separate nineteen-byte unrolled helper.
scope: Explicit shared-source v1.1 differences and physical geometry. Full-ROM equality, own decoded asset rebuilding, meaningful controls and reviewed inventory remain required; the profile alone is not acceptance.
code_window_scope: Physical emitted native instruction windows; official instructions, modes and boundaries are separately verified. Windows are not exclusive routines, and changed-byte controls must cover every physical source region.

retired_primary_controls.shift_left4: The standalone four-left-shift entry is absent. Its two callers inline four ASLs; the three-shift native entry remains. Existing caller controls and the new inline-source control replace this obsolete boundary.
retired_primary_controls.double_fe_pointer: The FE/FF doubling helper is absent; seven caller sites inline its instructions. Native source is checked per instruction, with the inline-source control.
retired_primary_controls.scale_position_by_eight: The standalone chained-shift entry is absent. Both callers inline three paired shifts, represented in the shared native-inlines source.
retired_primary_controls.shift_reference_right: The standalone reference-shift helper is absent; its three paired operations are inline in the position update.
retired_primary_controls.scale_world_shift: The standalone world-shift helper is absent. Its three accumulator/$11 shifts are inline in the source-owned coordinate function.
retired_primary_controls.shift_search_coordinate_right: The standalone search-coordinate shift is absent; its three paired shifts are inline in the source-owned bounds caller.
retired_primary_controls.shift_scrolled_slot_horizontal: The standalone horizontal-slot shift is absent; indexed paired shifts are inline in the source-owned fraction caller.
retired_primary_controls.pending_ppu_set_source: The standalone EA/EB source helper is absent. Its four instructions appear inline at both PPU consumers.
retired_primary_controls.advance_audio_command_two: There is no two-byte-advance entry. Every former call becomes two calls to the retained one-byte advance, which keeps its control.
retired_primary_controls.script_prefix_af02: The actual three-byte form is an encoded pointer to InteractionScriptAF05 and a trailing E0 field. The primary conditional branch-prefix opcode does not survive relocation. The typed pointer source has its own control.
retired_primary_controls.main_state_scale: Both standalone scroll-base doubling helpers are absent; their paired shifts occur inline in the state setup. Caller controls and the shared inline-source control cover the current representation.
retired_primary_controls.reset_dispatch: The reset-state validator/countdown does not exist in v1.2. Its own mapper pulse sequence and explicit conflict constants have replacement controls.
retired_primary_controls.scroll_x_tile_coordinate: This convenience entry is absent. Its callers load the X coordinate inline and call the retained generic shift; caller and generic-shift controls cover the actual forms.
retired_primary_controls.scroll_y_tile_coordinate: This convenience entry is absent. Its callers load the Y coordinate inline and call the retained generic shift; caller and generic-shift controls cover the actual forms.
retired_primary_controls.inferred_b0b0: The connected v1.1 B085/B0C0 scripts omit the entire jump statement. Its labelled start/end coincide; no replacement bytes or routine is required.
retired_primary_controls.direct_next_script_b0b3: The connected v1.1 script omits the related value-test and jump block. Its labelled start/end coincide; existing labels preserve shared alternate entries without byte ownership.
retired_primary_controls.slot_runtime_d6d7: The descriptor record and its following script are absent; the corresponding descriptor is unavailable in v1.1.
retired_primary_controls.bogus_d6e0: The entire34-byte sequence is absent between the revised contact script and retained D702 successor. Its descriptor is unavailable; no invented substitute is required.
retired_primary_controls.extended_script_ee62: The three-byte branch is absent along with the preceding jump; the retained flag setter falls through to the independently represented overlay jump.
retired_primary_controls.sweep_record_d3c0: The redundant nine-byte sentinel record is absent between the directly referenced record and script in v1.1. The logical extent collapses.
retired_primary_controls.script_opc4: The tenth sprite-record reservation field and C4 setter/dispatch entry do not exist in this release. The196-entry table and ten-byte stride are explicit and controlled.
retired_primary_controls.store_record_field_0a: The field0A setter has no body or callers in this ten-byte sprite-record version. The retained allocator and sprite consumers have own meaningful controls.
retired_primary_controls.fade_palette_load: The entire183-byte native fade helper and its24 declared command calls are absent. Existing palette-stream handlers plus explicit older palette-selection scripts remain controlled.
retired_primary_controls.fade_wait_vblank: The whole fade helper, including this vblank loop, is absent; no fabricated substitute is required.
